scope: Local synthetic rows through LocalSanitizer.admit with English declared. Not a general precision, recall or anonymity claim.
limits: English only; the caller declares the language and no detection runs.
Recognizers are the pinned local Presidio and spaCy en_core_web_sm models plus the bounded rule registry.
Contextual sensitivity (a value that is private only in context) is not detected.
Unsupported formats in the fixture are recorded as such; a miss there is expected, not a pass.

environment.note: Latency is wall time on the measuring machine during the final gate run and is not portable.
